scope: 50 PNG files directly in files/pict/artifacts; subdirectories unchanged
shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone RPG equipment inventory icon for a dark fantasy strategy game. Reference image 1 is the contact sheet of ORIGINAL items: find the cell labelled TARGET_FILENAME and preserve that item's basic identity, silhouette and characteristic colors. Reference images 2 and 3 are FINISHED art-quality examples only; do not copy their subjects into other items. Subject: SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION. Render as premium detailed hand-painted realistic game art, physically convincing crafted materials, sculpted dimensional metal/leather/fabric, crisp edges, broad readable silhouette and controlled fine engraving. One isolated item only, no character or mannequin, centered square canvas, complete item inside frame with at least 7% safe transparent padding. Long weapons diagonal from lower left to upper right, other items upright or three-quarter. Genuine transparent background and clean alpha, no scenery, no pedestal, no frame, no icon border, no lettering, no watermark, no checkerboard, no black background, no broad outer glow, no floating particles. Matching cohesive icon family, legible at 48-96 pixels. Output just the ONE named item, never a sheet.
